_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: message_user targets survive compaction and forks. A conversation with message_user on asked "Please check the build"; the agent replied "Looking now." to it with the reaction 👀, through message_user. Then the conversation was compacted (the old way: a new generation carrying copies of its messages) and forked twice, as /c/{{FORK}} and as the conversation with ID {{OTHER}} and slug {{OTHERSLUG}}. In the first fork the agent then replied "Still on it." to the original first message, through message_user. "The band" is the element with data-testid "carried-band" (the carried messages, collapsed). 1. Navigate to /c/{{FORK}}. 2. There should be exactly 1 band. 3. It must hold exactly 0 elements with data-testid "message" (collapsed). 4. In one eval without "expect", watch for highlights: new MutationObserver((records) => { for (const r of records) { const el = r.target; if (el.classList && el.classList.contains('message-highlight')) document.body.dataset.highlighted = el.innerText; } }).observe(document.body, { subtree: true, attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] }). 5. Click the element with data-testid "message-user-quote" inside the element with data-testid "message-user-bubble" containing "Still on it.". 6. The band's element with data-testid "message" containing "Please check the build" (within the band, has_text) should be visible: jumping expanded the band. 7. Eval (document.body.dataset.highlighted || '').includes('Please check the build') until it returns true. 8. That message's element with data-testid "message-reactions" should read exactly "👀". 9. Click the conversation list's '.conversation-item[data-conversation-id="{{OTHER}}"]': the band expanded here does not expand the same band in another conversation. 10. The URL should contain "{{OTHERSLUG}}". 11. The band's button (role "button", within the band) should have aria-expanded exactly "false".
